findings.title: parent points to a plan that does not exist
findings.why: `parent: "sw-life-cycle-1-plan"` and the body line 'planned in `sw-life-cycle-1-plan`' refer to a plan document that is not in the repository. Only plans 1-2 to 1-5 exist under docs/memory/plan. The same dangling parent is set in the 1-3, 1-4 and 1-5 plans. Any tool or reader following the parent link finds nothing, and the plan hierarchy is broken.

findings.title: Plan bodies only restate the task
findings.why: Each plan is a one-sentence summary and a link to its task. It has no approach, steps or acceptance points. For example, plan 1-5 names the refund policy but doesn't say how to deliver it.
